description: Parse a URL-style connection string with multiple hosts into one primary endpoint and ordered fallback endpoints.

cases.expected_output:
status=ok
host=foo
port=1
database=mydb
user=jack
password=secret
connect_timeout_seconds=0
tls=disabled
runtime_params={}
validate_connect=false
fallback.0.host=bar
fallback.0.port=2
fallback.0.tls=disabled
fallback.1.host=baz
fallback.1.port=3
fallback.1.tls=disabled
fallback_count=2

input.connection_string: user=jack password=secret host=foo,bar,baz port=1,2,3 dbname=mydb sslmode=disable

cases.expected_output:
status=ok
host=foo
port=1
database=mydb
user=jack
password=secret
connect_timeout_seconds=0
tls=disabled
runtime_params={}
validate_connect=false
fallback.0.host=bar
fallback.0.port=2
fallback.0.tls=disabled
fallback.1.host=baz
fallback.1.port=3
fallback.1.tls=disabled
fallback_count=2
